disclosure: Diagnostic only — not a published SLO.
interpretation: APPEND SHORT-CIRCUIT: no-append 532167 vs full 135023 ops/s (3.9×) — if ratio ≫1, append_frame (Blake+buffer) is the data-cooking hog.
APPEND SC + no-index: 634137 ops/s (vs no-append-with-index 532167) — residual after skipping Blake/append.
INDEX BISECT: no-index 142680 ≈ full 135023 ops/s (ratio 1.06×) — dual-index publish is NOT the killer; **data cooking** (encode/append/Blake+copy + write) dominates.
DISK BISECT: Discard 168977 / DevNull 158768 / Real 135023 ops/s — partial OS cost (Real/Discard=0.80×).
Raw /dev/null 3955696 vs raw work-file 1062831 ops/s — pure write_all media delta without Residiuum.
Buffered put is 47% of pure-Blake ops/s — Blake-scale cost may matter.
Memory 977310 → Discard-Buffered 168977 → Real-Buffered 135023: gap Memory→Discard is **pre-disk store work**; Discard→Real is **tail I/O**.
Raw write_all 1062831 ops/s vs Buffered put 135023 — store adds 7.9× wall vs raw same-size writes.
Note: long peer multi-seal runs can still add seal_rotate wall; this micro uses 512MiB seal so mid seals are off.
